skill.name: talking-head-recut
skill.description: Create timed graphic overlay cards for existing talking-head, interview, or podcast videos while preserving the source clip. It guides local transcription, storyboard planning, HTML card creation, and MP4 rendering with HyperFrames.
skill.summary: Add transcript-synced graphic overlays to existing talking-head videos.
skill.author: heygen-com

security_audit.summary: Most static hits are false positives from Markdown inline code, CSS border declarations, and a bundled minified GSAP library. The real security concern is operational: the skill asks the agent to run local CLI tools, including npx HyperFrames and ffmpeg/ffprobe, against user media. No prompt injection attempt or credential exfiltration instructions were found in the reviewed files.

remediation.suggestion: Pin and verify the HyperFrames package version before npx use, and run commands only in a project work directory with user-approved media paths.
Document source versions and hashes for GSAP and fonts, or include unminified source where practical.
Keep enforcing no external URLs, no scripts in card fragments, and relative-only assets before rendering.

Provides reference layouts, frames, and styles for 16:9, 9:16, and 4:5 output.
Assembles HTML card fragments with GSAP timelines and renders MP4 output.
limitations: Requires local HyperFrames, ffmpeg, ffprobe, and a headless browser environment.
Does not perform nonlinear editing such as reordering clips or changing audio.
Generated cards depend on transcript quality and manual correction of ASR errors.
Does not create video from a URL or topic alone.

best_practices: Confirm aspect ratio, layout, style, and card count before rendering.
Correct product names and technical terms in the transcript before designing cards.
Keep generated card HTML self-contained and avoid external URLs or scripts.
anti_patterns: Using this skill for plain subtitles when a caption-only workflow is enough.
Adding dense overlays that cover the speaker for long sections.
Rendering before checking timing, font availability, and video bounds.

faq.question: Does this edit the original video?
faq.answer: No. It keeps the source clip intact and adds graphic overlays in the rendered output.

faq.question: Does it create plain subtitles?
faq.answer: No. It is for designed overlay cards, lower-thirds, quotes, and callouts.

faq.question: What tools are required?
faq.answer: It requires HyperFrames, ffmpeg, ffprobe, local Whisper support, and a working render browser.

faq.question: Can it work with vertical video?
faq.answer: Yes. The workflow supports 9:16, 4:5, and 16:9 output canvases.

faq.question: Does it send media to a third-party service?
faq.answer: The skill describes local Whisper transcription through HyperFrames and does not require an API key.

faq.question: Can I choose the visual style?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes reference styles, layouts, and frame treatments for different tones.
